subject: LaunchForge cohort — earn-as-you-grow credit top-up and tax handling
messages:
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@launchforge.vc>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: LaunchForge Program Team <program@launchforge.vc>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LaunchForge cohort - credit structure question

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for running the cohort onboarding session last week — the teams loved the low-latency demo. A quick follow-up on the promotional stipend you offered: we received the standard 50k token credit per company, which is great, but a few of our later-stage teams are expecting to spike usage once they integrate.

Two asks from our side:
- Can Redwood offer a conditional top-up (additional 25k tokens) if a startup hits the cohort milestone (demo day + 10 paying customers) within 90 days?
- How does Redwood treat these credits from an accounting/tax standpoint (are they considered taxable income to the startups or a vendor credit)? Our finance team needs wording to pass to counsel.

We also want to avoid forcing teams onto a paid plan mid-cohort if they have a usage surge. If there are simple guardrails (monthly cap, auto-alerts), that would be ideal.

Attached is our draft mutual action plan and cohort milestone definitions. Can you let us know if Redwood can do the conditional top-up and what terms you’d need?

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Program Director, LaunchForge Ventures
LaunchForge_MA_plan.pdf (attached)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@launchforge.vc>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchForge cohort - credit structure question

Hi Alicia — great to hear the teams found the demo useful. We can support a conditional top-up; below is a pragmatic structure we propose so legal/finance can review quickly.

High-level proposal (summary):
- Base stipend: 50k token credit (no change).
- Conditional top-up: +25k token credit triggered if the startup meets both: (1) cohort milestone: demo day completed; (2) verified customer milestone: 10 distinct paying customers within 90 days of demo day.
- Delivery: top-up issued as a non-transferable account credit applied to the startup’s Redwood account. Not paid in cash.
- Cap & cadence: one top-up per company per cohort. Monthly soft-cap of 40k tokens billed as standard overage at 30% discount should usage spike before milestone verification.
- Alerts & controls: we’ll enable monthly usage alerts (admins + LAUNCHFORGE program). Auto-topup requires a signed milestone attestation from LaunchForge + a short verification step from Redwood CS.

Tax/accounting handling: we are not tax counsel, but precedent: credits issued as account credits (not cash) are generally treated by vendors as contra-revenue rather than direct income to recipients. To help your counsel, we’ll provide a short finance note that explains Redwood’s handling and suggests invoice/credit note language your accountants can rely on.

Attachments: I’m attaching a one-page proposed terms summary you can circulate to counsel and your finance team. If you prefer, Marissa (cc’d) can loop in our tax/accounting contact to do a quick call.

If that structure looks OK, we’ll draft a 1–2 paragraph amendment to the MAP that spells the trigger and delivery mechanics.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Growth, Redwood Inference
redwood-proposed-topup-terms.pdf (attached)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@launchforge.vc>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Finance Team <finance@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchForge cohort - credit structure question

Hi Alicia — quick note from sales ops/finance perspective. Ben’s proposal is fine operationally; two practical adjustments we recommend to avoid unintended tax treatment for startups:

1) Delivery as an invoice credit: instead of posting a standalone credit line on the startup account, we can issue a credit note that offsets future invoices for usage. That keeps the value on the vendor side as contra-revenue and avoids creating a cash-equivalent stipend.
2) Holdback for verification window: we suggest a 30-day holdback after milestone attestation so our CS team can validate the 10 paying customers claim. If validated, we convert the holdback to the credit note. If not validated, it expires.

We’ve attached a short finance note and a suggested clause you can drop into the MAP. If your counsel prefers different wording, we’re happy to run a redline. Also note: we can make credits valid for 12 months from issuance; if you need longer for cohort timelines we can discuss.

Let us know if LaunchForge wants a brief call between finance teams this week — I’m available Thu morning.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head, Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
finance-credit-note.txt (attached)
From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@launchforge.vc>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, LaunchForge Program Team <program@launchforge.vc>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LaunchForge cohort - credit structure question

Thanks Ben & Marissa — that all sounds reasonable and aligns with what our counsel was thinking. A few quick confirmations before we sign the MAP amendment:

- Confirm the top-up cap: +25k tokens one-time per company per cohort (agreed).
- Credits validity: 12 months from issuance is acceptable.
- Holdback: 30-day validation window works; please confirm you’ll notify us if validation fails and provide a short explanation.
- Alerts: monthly usage alerts to LaunchForge program email and to company admins.

If you can provide the 1–2 paragraph amendment and the finance note (for our counsel), we’ll route the MAP amendment for signature. I’m attaching the signed MAP v1 with our cohort milestone definitions filled in — please attach your amendment as an exhibit and we’ll countersign.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — a call isn’t necessary unless your finance team wants one.

Best,
Alicia Ramos
Program Director, LaunchForge Ventures
LaunchForge_signed-MAP-v1.pdf (attached)
